Also the three project_*_record_views tasks still ask learned extraction to produce original_index, which does not exist in Browser records. An objective saying copy-only is not deterministic projection. Replace these typed copies with existing foreach/value bindings: first foreach page exports its existing records field; explicit flatten gives the original ordered record collection; then a copy-only foreach exports an object with original_index={kind:index} and fields copied from the current item. Keep the original record separately or copy exact action fields. This pure projection compiles deterministically in the current profile; no mapping inference for indices, no per-record operation or learned mapping. The consumed view contains only ID and necessary text/type fields; action arguments remain in retained original records. Lookup resolves selected IDs to those records. If using indices as IDs use integer IDs throughout, not invented candidate_id strings or content hashes.
Remove learned classifications from build_product_candidate_view; candidate identity and typed fields must already exist before extraction. Classification/CAPTCHA decision belongs to interpret over the complete compact text, not to source-grounded extraction of fabricated booleans. prepare_candidate_decision_view must use typed projections for field copying, not a flat each over >1000 records. Retain bounded-page extract only for actual product text extraction where required; do not change its 1:1 nesting, complete coverage, guards or limits. Preserve every accepted requirement, real visits, original order, truthful missing values, real document writing result and cleanup. No new operations, public inputs, permissions, phases or increased limits. This explicit full implementation revision is necessary for those typed-copy corrections; keep the exact predicate above and all unaffected work.
